title: Prospective multi-protein extension of the #332 contact-denoising benchmark
status: Protocol specified before new-protein benchmark outcomes; not a public registry preregistration
prior_information: ADK results and its alpha=3,t=8 sharpening winner are development information. They are excluded from fresh confirmation.
objective: Test whether the binary expected-median construction linked to OpenAI/math family332 improves reconstruction of artificially corrupted simulated contacts over strong validation-selected controls.

mathematics.A: symmetric lazy reflecting path; adjacent entries1/4, interior diagonal1/2, endpoints3/4; one independent path per trajectory
mathematics.Y: 3H^2-2H^3 entrywise for binary input Z only
mathematics.claim_limit: The cotype theorem does not guarantee lower Brier error, biological accuracy, or physically realizable coordinates.

t4.construct: Use deposited construct exactly; record topology-derived sequence and modifications. Do not label wild type.
t4.qualification: Require published full-file MD5 verification, matching protein topology subset, continuous chronological trajectory, finite CA coordinates and whole-protein geometry.

ubiquitin.role: conditional second confirmation; qualification failure is a result
ubiquitin.expected: Native folded ensemble: five independent50ns runs, last40ns sampled40ps. Biased partial-fold ensembles are excluded.
ubiquitin.qualification: Require documented native identity, chronological frame order, exact five-run boundaries and unbiased native-production provenance. File length or apparent coordinate jumps alone do not prove order. If not verified, exclude from temporal benchmarking and report why; no silent substitute.
ubiquitin.split: After verified author mapping, ascending original run ID: first discovery, second validation, final three test.

villin.role: separately reported adaptive-sampling stress test, not primary confirmation
villin.eligibility: Finite complete single-protein CA trajectories with at least20 sampled frames. Exclude only objective topology/time/corruption failures; record all exclusions. No contact- or motion-based selection.
villin.split_algorithm: Use connected ancestral components within campaigns from parent-child filenames if their mapping is unambiguous. Hash component IDs with SHA256 and sort; if >=3 components, first max(1,floor(K/3)) discovery, next max(1,floor(K/3)) validation, remainder test. If <3 components or ancestry cannot be verified, use top-level campaigns in numeric/lexicographic order if >=3: first floor(K/3) discovery,next floor(K/3) validation,remainder test, explicitly flag unresolved dependence. If <3 campaigns, use ordered adaptive epochs with the same thirds and flag dependence. If fewer than3 identifiable epochs, temporal stress test is not eligible.
villin.sampling: Within each partition choose first24 discovery,24 validation,48 test trajectories ordered by SHA256 of canonical archive-relative path. Retain all if fewer. Minimum1 trajectory per partition; sample caps are fixed for tractability before outcomes.
villin.ancestry_caveat: Shared starting states and adaptive selection limit independence even when paths are disjoint; no equilibrium populations, folding rates or biological-replication inference.

preprocessing.sampling: Take first available production frame and exact integer stride from native cadence; no temporal interpolation. Require constant source cadence dividing200ps within1e-3ps; otherwise ineligible unless pre-outcome amendment records alternative.
preprocessing.equilibration: Use provided production trajectories; no additional motion-dependent trimming. Ubiquitin already excludes first10ns per source.
preprocessing.coordinates: CA only; float32 storage, float64 distance arithmetic; unwrap bonded protein when needed before extracting. Record actual sequence, residue IDs, chain IDs, units, selected atom indices and frame times.
preprocessing.pairs: One protein chain; positional sequence separation >=4; all nonlocal CA pairs eligible.
preprocessing.contact: Euclidean distance strictly less than cutoff; primary8Angstrom,7/9Angstrom sensitivity.
preprocessing.features: Select only nonconstant contacts across pooled discovery frames at each cutoff; test/validation never select features. If no features, dataset/scenario not evaluable.
preprocessing.rare: Discovery pooled contact frequency <=0.10 among selected features.
preprocessing.brief: Complete observed positive runs of duration <=600ps, i.e. at most3 sampled frames; omit runs touching trajectory boundaries. This is a sampled-run definition, not continuous-time lifetime.
preprocessing.coverage: For each held-out trajectory report all eligible pair count, selected pair count, total positive cells and fraction in discovery-constant-absent pairs. Primary scores cover only selected features.
preprocessing.independent_paths: Never smooth, infer events or calculate differences across trajectory or split boundaries.

filter_details.oracle: clip((H-epsilon)/(1-2epsilon),0,1); only binary-flip scenarios, including correlated flips; supplied actual epsilon makes this oracle-informed
filter_details.boundary: scipy half-sample symmetric reflect for finite-window filters; reflecting lazy-path endpoints for resolvent; each trajectory separate

noise.bitflip: Independent Bernoulli epsilon error per frame/contact, XOR clean binary contact.
noise.jitter: Independent mean-zero Gaussian noise, specified SD Angstrom, per frame/CA atom/Cartesian component, then threshold distances using same pairs.
noise.correlated: For each contact initialize E0~Bernoulli(epsilon); P(0->1)=epsilon*(1-rho)=.02 and P(1->0)=(1-epsilon)*(1-rho)=.18; independent chains per contact and trajectory; XOR clean.
noise.seeds: numpy.default_rng(numpy.random.SeedSequence([20261007,phase,dataset_id,run_index,scenario_index,noise_index])); phase1validation,2test; dataset_id t4=1,ubiquitin=2,villin=3; run_index from stable sorted complete dataset manifest; scenario_index is zero-based protocol order; noise_index zero-based.
noise.paired: Every method gets identical corrupted input within a trajectory/scenario/noise_index.

selection.objective: Mean Brier error, equal weight per validation trajectory then noise realization.
selection.method_settings: Choose each method settings independently by validation only; exact ties go to first candidate in protocol order. Save selection before any test-noise evaluation for that dataset/scenario.
selection.baseline: Single best validation-selected NONORACLE method other than paper332; tie order raw,linear,hard_linear,moving_average,gaussian,median,power_full,power_matched.
selection.matched_baseline: Same selection but exclude power_full; seven-candidate alpha3 family retains ADK winner and matches cubic candidate count.
selection.tuning_budget: Report every candidate count. Main comparison deliberately includes full63 power family; matched-budget contrast excludes it. Validation access identical. No test tuning or method additions.

aggregation: Mean over noise realizations within each test trajectory, then equal-weight trajectory means. For cross-protein descriptive summary, equal weight per protein; villin kept separate. Null strata remain null; do not silently coerce zero.

primary_success.missing_guardrail: If a required rare/brief positive stratum is absent on any test run, composite practical success is not fully evaluable; report other conditions.
primary_success.zero_baseline: Relative gain not evaluable when comparator Brier is zero.
primary_success.scope: Operational engineering threshold chosen before outcomes, not derived from theorem or a clinically/biologically validated meaningful-effect threshold. Apply against full-budget selected baseline; matched result secondary.

uncertainty: Report all test-run effects; noise-only paired95% Student-t intervals per run are descriptive conditional on its fixed reference trajectory. No biological p-values from noise seeds, frames or contacts; no claim of population generalization from3simulation runs. Report all prespecified scenarios, never choose a favorable one as primary.
clean_control: Apply every method settings chosen on primary noisy validation to clean test contacts without retuning. Include actual epsilon=.1 for oracle to expose its misspecification on clean input; label that fact. Report Brier/occupancy/brief/rare damage.
attribution: For each test noise draw, compare linear H and cubic phi(H) at cubic-selected t; report Brier and threshold disagreements. Real-arithmetic .5 classification equivalence may differ at floating-point ties; report any actual discrepancies.
execution: No denoising outcomes viewed before this protocol is frozen and saved. Metadata, source publications and geometric input-integrity checks are allowed. Code corrections are versioned; statistical rules cannot be changed silently after outcomes. Record protocol/code/input hashes with results.
review: After benchmarks, five independent AI agents review mathematics/implementation, dataset/provenance, statistics/protocol, citations/claims, and numerical reproduction. These are AI technical audits, not human peer review.
release: Save protocol, immutable results, source/checksum provenance, executable code, environment, reviews and report. Confirm source data terms before public redistribution; no GitHub publication is authorized by this task.
